notes.title: The Un-BEATable Game... is Delayed
notes.content:
Progress is going well, it has just happened that the scope of the game and its complexity is bigger than I had anticipated. Creating the most revolutionary game ever made is hard work after all. My goal is to make the game and its concept justice so that when you inevitably actually buy the game and play it, It will be so hard that it will make a game reviewer want to cry. 

There is no planned release date at this moment. However, I can assure you that it will come in the next decade. I will be sure to inform you immediately when I actually know when the game is close to completion.

Thanks so much for sticking with this project!

Can you beat it?
- Vittorio Corbo
